title: Toxic (Hindi Ver)
synopsis: Set in a bygone era, this gripping tale unfolds in the coastal paradise of Goa, where a powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches and vibrant culture.

synopsis_lang.en: Set in a bygone era, this gripping tale unfolds in the coastal paradise of Goa, where a powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches and vibrant culture.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 本故事背景設定於一個逝去的時代，在陽光璀璨的沙灘與活力四射的文化背後，一個勢力龐大的販毒集團在暗中操縱一切。這段扣人心絃的傳奇，就在海濱天堂果阿（Goa）展開。
